en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 7. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, and from ‘Abdil Raḥmān ibn Abī Najrān, from someone, from ‘Abbās ibn Walīd, from his father, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
The Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) said, “Those who hate Ḥasan and Ḥusain (a.s.) will come on the Day of Judgment without any flesh on their faces and they will be excluded from my intercession.”
